ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Calculate the operating frequency of the following oscillator circuit, if \(C_1 = 0.027 \, \mu F\) and \(L_1 = 105 \, mH\), as shown in the figure. The operating frequency is ______ kHz.
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: On the left side of the figure is an LC resonant circuit, with capacitor C1 and inductor L1 connected in parallel; this LC circuit is connected through coupling capacitor C2 to the transistor amplifier circuit on the right side. On the right side, bias resistors R1 and R2, collector resistor RC, emitter resistor RE, and bypass capacitor CE can also be seen. Reasoning calculation: The operating frequency of the oscillator is determined by the parallel LC resonant circuit on the left side, using the formula f = 1/(2π√(L1 C1)). It is known that C1 = 0.027 μF = 0.027 × 10^-6 F = 2.7 × 10^-8 F, L1 = 105 mH = 105 × 10^-3 H = 0.105 H. Substitute: L1C1 = 0.105 × 2.7 × 10^-8 = 2.835 × 10^-9; √(L1C1) ≈ 5.324 × 10^-5. Therefore f = 1/(2π × 5.324 × 10^-5) ≈ 2989 Hz = 2.989 kHz, approximately 3.0 kHz.
